name: Anna University
campuses: School of Architecture and Planning (SAP), Guindy
summary: Anna University was established on 4 September 1978 as a unitary state university. Its Chennai university departments are the College of Engineering, Guindy (CEG — tracing its history back over 230 years), the A.C. College of Technology (ACT), the School of Architecture and Planning (SAP), both in Guindy, and the Madras Institute of Technology (MIT) in Chromepet. B.E./B.Tech. seats for Tamil Nadu students are filled through TNEA counselling on Class XII marks — there is no entrance test — while NRI, CIWGC and foreign-national seats are filled by the university's Centre for Admissions.

applicationPlatform.value: TNEA online counselling (tneaonline.org) for Tamil Nadu students; Anna University Centre for Admissions for NRI, CIWGC and foreign nationals

testing.test: TNEA counselling (Class XII marks; no entrance test)

domesticTuition.notes: CEG tuition per semester; development, library, computer and lab charges are extra (see breakdown).
